in_marathi.name: Namya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Name of the Goddess
in_marathi.long_meaning: Namya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Namya is a name of the goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge, learning, and art. It is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘namas’, meaning ‘to bow’ or ‘to offer obeisance’. The name signifies the act of seeking knowledge and offering respect to the divine source of wisdom.
